FR-001.title: The Countries side nav MUST list, in order: Overview, History, Provinces, Locations, Military, Government, Estates, Values, Subjects, Economy, Building Registry, Characters.

FR-002.title: The Countries side nav MUST NOT show Trade or Diplomacy.

FR-003.title: Economy, Building Registry and Characters MUST show the app's Coming Soon page.

FR-004.title: Every tab MUST show data for the nation picked in the Countries nation selector and update when that selection changes.

FR-005.title: Overview MUST show government type, treasury, economic base, stability, government power, prestige, works of art, literacy rate, number of locations, total debt and monthly income for the selected nation.

FR-006.title: The government power stat MUST be labeled with the name the game uses for the nation's government type (for example Legitimacy for a monarchy).

FR-007.title: Economic base MUST be the nation's most recent recorded economic base value.

FR-008.title: Literacy rate MUST be the average literacy of the nation's population, weighted by population size.

FR-009.title: Total debt MUST be the sum of every outstanding loan the nation has borrowed.

FR-010.title: Works of art MUST count the works the nation owns that are not destroyed.

FR-011.title: Overview MUST show four pie charts of the nation's population, by religion, by culture, by estate and by social class, each slice sized by population.

FR-012.title: Stats that are computed from several save values, not read from one, MUST be marked as computed, in text and not by color alone.

FR-013.title: History MUST show population, economic base, tax base and ruler history charts on one page.

FR-014.title: History MUST open with only the selected nation shown and MUST let the player add other nations to compare.

FR-015.title: Provinces MUST add a column for each province-level value the map modes show.

FR-016.title: Locations MUST list every location the selected nation owns, one row each, with a column for each location-level value the map modes show.

FR-017.title: Every column in Provinces and Locations MUST be sortable.

FR-018.title: Military MUST show the selected nation's army composition with the same content as the Firepower army composition view.

FR-019.title: Military MUST show the selected nation's naval composition, grouping its ships by type.

FR-020.title: Military MUST show the military doctrine chart for the selected nation only.

FR-021.title: Government MUST list the selected nation's laws in force (Policies) and granted estate privileges (Estate Privileges) under separate headings, by readable name.

FR-022.title: Estates MUST show, for each estate the nation has: satisfaction, tax rate, population share, gold, monthly balance, wealth impact, and last month's income and expenses.

FR-023.title: Values MUST show the societal values of the selected nation only.

FR-024.title: Subjects MUST show a tree rooted at the selected nation, with each subject nested under its overlord, down every level.

FR-025.title: Each subject node MUST show the subject's name and subject type.

FR-026.title: Clicking a live subject MUST select that nation in the nation selector and open its Overview tab.

FR-027.title: Any value the save does not have for a nation MUST be labeled as not available, never shown as zero.

FR-028.title: Every table, chart and tree in this feature MUST be keyboard-operable and must not rely on color alone to carry meaning.

FR-029.title: Hover details MUST use the app's styled hover tooltip, not the browser's native tooltip.

FR-030.title: Each policy and estate privilege on the Government tab MUST show its in-game effects on hover and when selected
